run.requirements: Direct Stock Token and USDG custody with a manual Delta LP adapter

summary.building: Direct Stock Token and USDG custody with a manually operated self-custodied Delta V3 ladder adapter
summary.topRisk: A mismatched Delta token, pool, route, or runtime hash can direct backing into the wrong market
summary.mustDecideFirst: Pin the collection-specific INJOH token, pool, feeds, routes, position limit, and allocation cap
summary.watchOutFor: Live V3 fees are conservatively omitted from NAV until collected

risks.title: External-call lifecycle risk
risks.detail: Adapter calls require reentrancy protection, measured receipts, and cleared temporary allowances

risks.title: Ownership handoff risk
risks.detail: Two-step registry ownership must be accepted before production activation

risks.title: Restricted-holder incompatibility
risks.detail: Production exposure requires a counsel-approved holder eligibility policy

risks.title: Multiplier double counting
risks.detail: The official per-token price feed already includes the Stock Token multiplier

risks.title: Activation binding mismatch
risks.detail: The collection deployment must bind the same token, pool, feeds, routes, factory, position manager, builder, caps, and runtime hashes

risks.title: Conservative fee valuation
risks.detail: Live fees not yet crystallized into tokensOwed are omitted from adapter NAV until collection

preCodingDecisions.title: Collection Delta bindings
preCodingDecisions.detail: Exact INJOH token, pool, feeds, routes, addresses, runtime hashes, maximum positions, cap, and loss policy are required before activation

requirementsCorrections.detail: Stock Token dividends are reinvested through uiMultiplier rather than separately paid to the sleeve
USDG is a direct holding in the MVP and must not be described as a yield sleeve
Every production collection must explicitly bind its Delta token, pool, feeds, routes, dependencies, runtime hashes, and caps
